attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1 (10.100.235.10), node2 (10.100.235.11), node3 (10.100.235.12) on RHEL 10, managed by systemd with static bootstrap discovery and firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened. Verified cross-member reads/writes, availability and correct recovery/catch-up during a member outage, and completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart cluster health/quorum verification.
